metadata.title: How Anthropic’s rise is fueling Nvidia - MarketWatch

content.text:
49 min ago
How Anthropic’s rise is fueling Nvidia
Anthropic's fast growth is giving a boost to Nvidia, the so-called Bank of AI.
On Nvidia's Tuesday earnings call, interim CEO Colette Kress said she expects the major frontier AI labs to contribute 15% of Nvidia's data-center revenue in the current fiscal year, which ends in January. She cited new model releases from Anthropic and rival OpenAI, as well as Anthropic's annualized revenue of $81 billion at the end of October.
"As frontier models become more capable, adoption and revenue are scaling rapidly," Kress said.
